title: Proposed withdrawal of s87B undertaking of Babcock and Brown Infrastructure and Babcock and Brown Power

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.

ACCC requested further information from the parties. ACCC timeline suspended. Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings, of 27 January 2010, amended to allow parties to respond to information request.
ACCC received further information from the parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.

ACCC requested further information from the parties. Former proposed date for announcement of ACCC's findings, of 31 March 2010, amended to allow for parties to respond to the ACCC's information request. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from the parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
Alinta Energy withdrew its application to withdraw the undertaking.
